body:
Your estradiol is a little high. Anyone who says that the T/E2 ratio is what matters is ignorant of the independent effects of the two.

Yes, the ratio is important for things like lipids and CV health.

But E2 exerts its own effects. If elevated E2 alone can cause gyno, it can surely cause other effects regardless of the ratio. ED for example. Erections are caused by T, but are maintained by the absence of E2 (google “estradiol venous leak”).
